decisions.reason: Making the unimplemented Card checkout option unavailable does not alter the deferred Transak flow's required provider, supported methods, wallet provisioning, or mint behavior.
The checkout-option availability correction does not change the mint price or revenue allocation.
The payment-option correction does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited supply.
USDC remains selectable, and the source does not change the required connected-wallet USDC mint behavior.
The candidate already requires ETH as a supported wallet payment asset; stating that ETH should be selectable introduces no new candidate state.
Payment-method availability does not affect the optional gratuity feature or its configured amounts.
The source changes which checkout option is unavailable but does not change when mint-success feedback should appear.
Restoring ETH option selectability does not resolve or modify ETH pricing, excess-payment treatment, or refund semantics.
The source requests a checkout availability correction and does not direct a change to the approved FAQ copy or its description of the intended fiat flow.
Checkout payment-option availability is unrelated to secondary-sale royalty amount, disclosure, standard, or marketplace enforcement.
The source does not change no-referral commission amounts, triggers, or recipient selection.
Payment-option availability does not affect the randomness provider, selection execution, fairness, or applicable prize draws.
